title: Host-parity governed PR review
summary: One host-neutral ReviewKernel session owns pinned target, DoR, routing, consent, sandbox validation, partial-safe collection, audited mechanical repair, affected-slot retry, criterion evidence, lossless artifacts, bounded inline presentation, and final gate across Claude and Codex.

current_state.summary: ReviewKernel already normalizes free-form consent and host-observed execution, records disposable push-disabled sandboxes, routes/leases/collects slots, and uses immutable content-addressed evidence, bounded v3 views, canonical revisions and projections. Durable command execution and bounded inline dashboard pages exist. Collection is complete-only and no canonical DoR/criterion ledger, consent scope, provisional revision, constrained repair/retry, or atomic lossless JSON/Markdown/HTML set spans both hosts.

alternatives.name: Canonical ReviewKernel session with thin host adapters
alternatives.description: Extend incumbent evidence/runtime/presentation seams with host-neutral DoR, consent, partial revision, repair, retry and artifact contracts.

gains: One authority and semantic host parity
tradeoffs.revisit_when: A future host cannot transport the canonical interaction/event schema without losing required evidence.

alternatives.name: Host-owned orchestration over shared results
alternatives.description: Let Claude and Codex independently discover, consent, retry and present, sharing only result schemas.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: Host policy prevents a canonical state machine and parity is explicitly removed.

alternatives.name: Complete-only collection and full reruns
alternatives.description: Retain all-or-nothing collection and rerun every producer on any invalid slot.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: Producer cost becomes negligible and provisional evidence is prohibited.

decision: Use synchronous ReviewKernel as the single state owner; add focused domain modules for DoR/session/recovery/artifacts, keep host adapters transport-only, use durable commands for dynamic work, immutable revisions for partial/canonical truth, and bounded dashboard projections over lossless artifacts.

contracts.description: Host-neutral routed lease/result lifecycle supports partial freezing and affected-only retries without rewriting valid slots.
Immutable provisional non-approvable revision inventories valid, missing and invalid slots and is explicitly superseded.
Audited allowlist repairs only lease-derived declarations with before/after equivalence proof; substance reruns affected slot.
Provenance-bound source discovery, dynamic classification, contradictions and per-criterion evidence ledger.
Claude/Codex transport canonical prompts, consent, observed tools and interactive receipts without review authority.
One free-form-normalized complete-review scope; re-consent only for enumerated authority changes or final disposition.
Bounded accessible revision-bound pages expose decision evidence and signed action receipts.
Atomic lossless semantically equivalent JSON, Markdown and HTML projections for every provisional/canonical revision.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC1: The same pinned PR, requirements, options, and deterministic lens fixtures on Claude and Codex produce semantically equivalent DoR, routing, leases, validation, findings, collection, gate, and JSON/Markdown/HTML results, with only transport metadata differing.
acceptance_map.validation: Cross-host golden runs one fixture through both adapters, strips transport metadata, and asserts byte-identical canonical semantic model and artifact counts.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC2: Fixtures for PR title/body/comments, commits, changelog, linked issue/spec/acceptance text, and repository contracts prove every available source is checked before routing with identity and revision provenance; missing, inaccessible, contradictory, and stale sources are explicit.
acceptance_map.validation: Eight-source discovery matrix asserts one provenance/status row per available or attempted source before routing and explicit four-state failures.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC3: Paraphrase, bullet, prose, commit, changelog, comment, conflict, and non-requirement fixtures are dynamically classified as objective, acceptance criterion, review directive, constraint, or context; one clarification occurs only when ambiguity materially changes review.
acceptance_map.validation: Classifier corpus covers all eight forms and five classes; ambiguity metamorphic test asserts clarification_count is 0 or 1 only when routing/verdict changes.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC4: Every extracted criterion is rendered as pass, fail, unproven, or not-applicable with rationale, evidence reference, verification method, and responsible lens/step; unproven or unjustified not-applicable prevents approval.
acceptance_map.validation: Criterion ledger schema/negative gate tests require all six fields and assert unproven or unsubstantiated n/a disables approval.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC5: Semantic variants of security, bugs, usability, scale performance, quality, and architecture directives route applicable catalog lenses separately from feature acceptance criteria and do not silently suppress executable validation.
acceptance_map.validation: Directive paraphrase corpus asserts six independent catalog routes plus retained executable-validation decision and separate feature criteria.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC6: One complete-review choice covering all then-known non-destructive options reaches the final human gate without repeated render, dynamic, collection, repair, retry, or artifact approvals, and free-form equivalent consent works without an exact phrase.
acceptance_map.validation: Consent state-machine test supplies paraphrases and full option set; asserts one initial consent and no intermediate approval through final gate.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC7: A new approval is requested only for changed target/scope, newly destructive/external action, permission/credential escalation, unsafe operation, irreconcilable requirement ambiguity, or final disposition, and names the new fact and authority needed.
acceptance_map.validation: Seven-case authority matrix asserts exactly six midflow trigger classes plus final disposition, each with fact/authority; all other transitions request none.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC8: With zero, one, several, or all invalid/missing slots, valid findings remain in an immutable provisional revision with per-slot reasons, explicit incompleteness, disabled approval, stable provenance, and later supersession into a canonical revision.
acceptance_map.validation: 0/1/several/all-invalid matrix asserts immutable retained valid fingerprints, reasons, non-approvable flag, and explicit supersession into one canonical revision.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC9: The observed valid fail/one-finding frontend result with unresolved free-form declaration identity is mechanically repaired from leased authority and collected without substantive rerun; changed findings, evidence, target, producer, slot, or unverifiable identity cannot be repaired and rerun only the affected slot.
acceptance_map.validation: Captured frontend fixture repairs declaration from lease with equivalence proof and zero producer calls; six tamper fixtures reject repair and increment only affected producer.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC10: Mixed-result retries invoke only affected producers; valid slots are neither re-reviewed nor rewritten, collection is idempotent, and final canonical output contains no duplicated findings.
acceptance_map.validation: Mixed 26-slot fault test asserts retry call set equals affected ids, valid artifact digests unchanged, repeated collection identical, and unique finding identities.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC11: On both hosts, inline interaction tests prove target/revision, DoR status/sources, expandable criterion evidence, lens status, severity/lens/file findings with rationale/action, dynamic evidence, provisional gaps, provenance, gate reason, filtering, keyboard navigation, and action receipts; approval controls are enabled only for complete approvable revisions.
acceptance_map.validation: Claude/Codex DOM/interaction suite asserts every named field/control, focus preservation, keyboard operation, filtering and revision-bound receipts; incomplete revisions disable approve.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC12: Publishing a provisional or canonical revision automatically writes JSON, Markdown, and HTML containing complete DoR, criterion evidence, slot/lens status, all findings, dynamic evidence, collection/provenance, and gate state; a 120-finding round trip proves semantic equality and identical counts without a prompt.
acceptance_map.validation: Publish transaction round-trips a 120-finding revision through all formats and asserts semantic equality/counts and zero consent/prompt calls.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC13: Reviews at least as large as 126 KiB Markdown and 342 KiB HTML plus multi-megabyte fixtures dispatch every selected slot, retain every finding in exports, render inline by bounded pages/references, and preserve one revision/provenance across pages without making dashboard bytes producer input.
acceptance_map.validation: Scale fixture enforces stated sizes, all selected slots, complete export counts, each page <=14000 bytes, one revision identity, and no dashboard dependency in producer views.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC14: Host limitation, unavailable dynamic check, invalid reference, renderer failure, artifact-write failure, and unrepaired-slot injection produce stable actionable non-success states and never zero findings, declined-user-choice, completed review, or pass.
acceptance_map.validation: Six-fault injection matrix asserts named stable non-success with action, retained findings/choice, and completed/pass false.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC15: Broken-build dynamic validation operates only in a disposable review copy: the pinned checkout/ref and remote remain unchanged, no push occurs, sandbox delta is evidence, and final output distinguishes submitted-PR from sandbox outcomes.
acceptance_map.validation: Broken-build integration records pre/post pinned/remote fingerprints, push attempts zero, sandbox delta reference, and distinct submitted/sandbox verdict fields.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC16: Existing complete small-review goldens retain routing, findings, gates, and artifact consumers unchanged or through an explicit versioned migration, with no test removal, skip, xfail, lowered floor, or weakened governance assertion.
acceptance_map.validation: Legacy golden/migration suite asserts semantic parity and consumer compatibility; repository test audit rejects removals, skip/xfail additions, lowered thresholds or weakened assertions.

risks.risk: Host adapters become parallel policy authorities.
risks.mitigation: Canonical session emits all decisions; adapters accept/return versioned transport envelopes only; parity goldens strip transport metadata.

risks.risk: Classifier mistakes context for acceptance or directives.
risks.mitigation: Provenance spans, confidence, contradiction links, deterministic corpus and one material-ambiguity clarification.

risks.risk: Mechanical repair changes substantive review meaning.
risks.mitigation: Allowlist lease-derivable fields only; canonical before/after equivalence proof; any content/evidence identity change reruns affected slot.

risks.risk: Provisional revisions are mistaken for approval-ready truth.
risks.mitigation: Schema-level incomplete/non-approvable state, missing-slot inventory, disabled UI action, explicit supersession.

risks.risk: Large artifacts break inline UX or truncate exports.
risks.mitigation: Lossless content-addressed artifact transaction plus bounded referenced pages with count/semantic round-trip checks.

risks.risk: Dynamic build repair modifies submitted PR or remote.
risks.mitigation: Disposable push-disabled copy, before/after git/remote observations, sandbox-only delta evidence and separate outcomes.
Additive versions, dual-read/dual-project phase, compatibility goldens, retained legacy complete projection.

failure_modes.mode: DoR source inaccessible, stale, or contradictory.
failure_modes.detection: review_dor_source records source identity, revision and status.
failure_modes.recovery: DoR owner records explicit gap; session continues non-approvable or requests one clarification only if interpretation changes.

failure_modes.detection: review_consent compares target/options/authority fingerprint at each transition.
failure_modes.recovery: Session owner pauses once and requests only the new fact-specific authority; prior results remain immutable.

failure_modes.mode: One or more slots are missing or invalid.
failure_modes.recovery: Collector freezes provisional revision immediately and recovery owner retries affected slots at most twice.

failure_modes.mode: Mechanical repair is unverifiable or changes substance.
failure_modes.detection: review_repair reports allowlist, derivation and before/after equivalence fingerprints.
failure_modes.recovery: Recovery owner rejects repair and reruns only affected producer, maximum two attempts.

failure_modes.mode: Dynamic sandbox cannot run or escapes policy.
failure_modes.detection: review_dynamic_sandbox reports disposable/push-disabled identity, command outcome and pre/post observations.
failure_modes.recovery: Validation owner stops commands, records unavailable or unsafe non-success, preserves submitted PR and does not synthesize pass.

failure_modes.detection: review_artifact_publish reports per-format temp digest, parse result and transaction state.
failure_modes.recovery: Artifact publisher leaves revision intact, advertises no partial set, retries transaction at most twice, then stable unavailable.

failure_modes.mode: Inline action receipt is stale, forged, or inaccessible.
failure_modes.detection: review_inline_action validates session/revision/action/consent fingerprint and host observation.
failure_modes.recovery: Presentation owner rejects action, preserves focus/state, refreshes bounded page, and requests no new review approval.

signals: review_consent: scope fingerprint, trigger class, new fact and authority
review_slot_revision: expected/valid/invalid/missing/reused sets and provisional/canonical identity
review_repair: rule/version, derivation, before/after/equivalence fingerprints and outcome
review_retry: affected slot ids, attempt, producer calls, reused result count and cost
review_dynamic_sandbox: disposable/push-disabled identity, pre/post fingerprints, command and delta refs
review_artifact_publish: revision, format digests/counts, semantic equality and transaction state
review_inline_action: session/revision/action receipt, keyboard/focus result and outcome
alerts: Block approval for incomplete, unproven, unjustified n/a, artifact mismatch or stale consent.
Block repair when equivalence is absent or substance differs.
Block dynamic work on non-disposable or push-capable checkout.
Alert when repair or affected-slot retry exceeds two attempts.
Alert when inline page exceeds 14000 bytes or producer view exceeds 16384 bytes.

rollout.strategy: Add versioned schemas behind TASKPLANE_CANONICAL_PR_REVIEW. Dual-run existing small goldens first; enable DoR/consent, provisional collection, repair/retry, artifact transaction, inline presentation, then cross-host authority. Retain legacy complete projections/readers throughout.
rollout.rollback: Disable new session creation; finish issued leases with retained schema readers/resolvers; publish legacy complete projections for canonical revisions. Immutable provisional/canonical revisions and artifacts remain readable and are never rewritten or deleted; no simultaneous host deployment is required.

visualization.reason: The host-neutral flow, immutable provisional-to-canonical supersession, lossless artifact set and bounded inline projection are otherwise easy to conflate.

lens_evidence.evidence: Applied verified Python reference; grounded design in existing consent, sandbox, evidence, bounded-view, command and dashboard seams; compared canonical, host-owned and complete-only options; mapped all 16 exact criteria to named contracts/modules and executable parity, classifier, consent, slot, repair, scale, accessibility, sandbox and compatibility tests; matched failures to declared signals and bounded recovery; additive rollback preserves issued leases and legacy readers; module ownership/order are explicit; no unresolved Build decision or silent debt.
